topics.title: to be
topics.rule:
Ma'nosi: "bo'lmoq / -man, -san, -dir". Hozirgi paytda 3 shakli bor:

KimShakl
Iam
he / she / it / birlik otis
we / you / they / ko'plik otare

Inkor: am/is/are + not. Savol: to be gap boshiga chiqadi (Are you tired?).

She is a teacher. Are they at home?

Signal so'zlar: nowtodayat the moment — hozirgi holat.

questions.explain: Savolda to be boshiga chiqadi, "you" bilan "are".
"You" bilan doim "are" ishlatiladi. Savol so'zi (Where) dan keyin ham to be turadi: Where are you from?
Keys ko'plik, shuning uchun "are". "Is" faqat bitta narsa bilan ishlatiladi.
"She" bilan doim "is" keladi: She is not (isn't) at home.
"I" savolda ham "am" bilan keladi: Am I late? "Is I" va "Are I" hech qachon ishlatilmaydi.
Ali and I = we (ikki kishi), shuning uchun "are". "Am" faqat yolg'iz "I" bilan.

topics.title: Present Simple
topics.rule:
Qachon: doimiy, takroriy ishlar, odatlar va haqiqatlar.

Tuzilishi: I/you/we/they + fe'l. He/she/it + fe'l+s/es.

Inkor: don't / doesn't + fe'l. Savol: Do / Does + ega + fe'l. Does/doesn't dan keyin -s YO'Q!

-s/-es qoidasi: o, s, ch, sh, x bilan tugasa -es (go→goes, watch→watches). Undosh+y → -ies (study→studies).

He plays football every day.

Signal so'zlar: alwaysusuallyoftensometimesneverevery dayon Mondaysonce a week
topics.pattern: he/she/it + fe'l-s. do/does dan keyin -s yo'q.
topics.tip: "S" gapda faqat bitta joyda bo'ladi: Does she play? (does da s bor, play da yo'q).

questions.explain: "go" o bilan tugaydi, shuning uchun -es: goes.
"Do" dan keyin fe'l oddiy shaklda turadi.
"Never" — Present Simple signali. "She" birlik, shuning uchun fe'lga -s qo'shiladi: drinks.
"He" bilan savolda "does" keladi. Visit esa -s siz qoladi, chunki asosiy fe'l oddiy shaklda turadi.

questions.q: We ___ go to school on Sunday.

questions.explain: Doimiy ish joyi — Present Simple. Sister = she, shuning uchun works.
"The train" = it, savol "Does" bilan tuziladi. "Is leave" grammatik xato.

topics.title: Present Continuous
topics.rule:
Qachon: aynan hozir yoki shu kunlarda davom etayotgan ish.

Tuzilishi: am/is/are + fe'l+ing.

Inkor: am/is/are not + -ing. Savol: Are you reading?

-ing qoidasi: make→making (e tushadi), run→running (undosh ikkilanadi).

Diqqat: know, like, love, want, have (egalik) kabi holat fe'llari -ing bilan ishlatilmaydi.

Look! It is raining.

Signal so'zlar: nowright nowat the momentLook!Listen!today
topics.tip: Look!, Listen!, now ni ko'rsangiz → to be + ING. know, like, want ga -ing qo'shilmaydi.
topics.mistake: "I am know" yoki to be ni tushirib qoldirish.

questions.q: I ___ a book at the moment.

questions.explain: Qisqa undosh bilan tugasa, undosh ikkilanadi.

questions.q: He ___ his car at the moment.

questions.explain: Hozir bo'layotgan ish. Continuous savoli: so'roq so'zi + are/is + ega + -ing. "You" bilan "are".
Continuous inkori: is + not + -ing. "Mary" = she, shuning uchun isn't.
"They" bilan "are" keladi: Where are they going?

questions.q: I ___ my homework at the moment.
questions.explain: "At the moment" — hozirgi payt. "I" bilan am + doing.

topics.title: can
topics.rule:
Ma'nosi: qila olmoq (qobiliyat) yoki ruxsat so'rash.

Tuzilishi: ega + can + fe'l (oddiy shakl). Hamma shaxslarga bir xil: he can, NOT he cans.

Inkor: can't / cannot. Savol: Can + ega + fe'l? Do/does kerak emas!

She can swim. Can you help me?
topics.tip: can "qattiq" so'z: unga -s, to, do/does yopishmaydi.

questions.explain: Savolda "Can" boshiga chiqadi, do kerak emas.

questions.q: I ___ run fast. I'm too slow.
He ___ drive a car. He is 8.

questions.explain: Qila olmaslik "can't" bilan ifodalanadi. "Doesn't can" xato, chunki can bilan do/does ishlatilmaydi.
"Can" ruxsat so'rashda ham ishlatiladi: Can I...?
"Can" dan keyin fe'l oddiy shaklda: speak. "She" bo'lsa ham -s qo'shilmaydi.
So'roq so'zi + can + ega + fe'l: What can you do?

topics.title: was / were
topics.rule:
Ma'nosi: to be ning o'tgan zamoni.

KimShakl
I / he / she / itwas
we / you / theywere

Inkor: wasn't / weren't. Savol: Was he...? Were you...?

I was at home yesterday.

Signal so'zlar: yesterdaylast weekagoin 2010last night
topics.tip: "You" bir kishiga ham were bo'ladi: You were.

questions.q: The kids ___ in the park an hour ago.
___ you at the party on Friday?
There ___ a book on the table yesterday.
There ___ two men in the room.
My parents ___ in Italy last year.
We ___ tired yesterday. We felt fine.
My friends ___ at the cinema last night.
I ___ not at school last Monday.
questions.explain: "I" o'tgan zamonda "was" bilan keladi. Inkori: wasn't.

topics.title: Past Simple
topics.rule:
Qachon: o'tgan zamonda tugagan ish.

To'g'ri fe'llar: fe'l + ed (play→played, study→studied).

Noto'g'ri fe'llar: yodlash kerak: go→went, see→saw, have→had, make→made, take→took, write→wrote, get→got, come→came, buy→bought, lose→lost, spend→spent.

Inkor: didn't + oddiy fe'l. Savol: Did + ega + oddiy fe'l. Did dan keyin 2-shakl ISHLATILMAYDI!

She went to Samarkand last year.

Signal so'zlar: yesterdaylast nighttwo days agoin 2015when I was a child
topics.tip: Did gapda bor bo'lsa, o'tgan zamon belgisi allaqachon berilgan, fe'l "toza" qoladi.

questions.q: She ___ a lot of money last month.

questions.explain: "Do" noto'g'ri fe'l: do → did. "Last night" o'tgan zamon belgisi.
"See" noto'g'ri fe'l: see → saw. "Seen" boshqa zamonda (Perfect) ishlatiladi.
"Didn't" o'tgan zamonni o'zi ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun fe'l oddiy shaklda: like.

questions.q: She ___ a new phone last week.

questions.explain: Savol: so'roq so'zi + did + ega + oddiy fe'l. Arrive — 1-shaklda qoladi.

topics.title: at / in / on
topics.rule:
Vaqt uchun:

AT — aniq soat: at 7 o'clock; at night, at noon, at the weekend.

ON — kun va sana: on Monday, on 5 June, on Saturday evening.

IN — oy, yil, fasl, kun qismi: in May, in 2020, in summer, in the morning.

Joy uchun: at — nuqta (at home, at school), on — sirt ustida (on the table, on the wall), in — ichida/shahar (in the box, in Tashkent).
topics.pattern: at - soat, on - kun/sana, in - oy/yil/fasl.
topics.tip: Uchburchak: IN eng katta vaqt, ON o'rta (kun), AT eng kichik (soat).

questions.explain: Hafta kuni + kun qismi bo'lsa "on": on Friday morning.
Aniq sana bilan "on". Faqat oy yoki yil bo'lsa "in" ishlatilardi.
Kun qismi bilan "in" ishlatiladi: in the afternoon.

topics.title: some / any / no
topics.rule:
SOME — darak gaplarda: I have some apples. Shuningdek taklif va iltimosda: Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?

ANY — inkor va savol gaplarda: I don't have any money. Do you have any milk?

NO = not any. Darak gap shaklida, lekin inkor ma'no beradi: I have no money. ("no" bilan fe'l inkor bo'lmaydi.)
topics.pattern: some - darak/taklif, any - savol/inkor, no - o'zi inkor.
topics.tip: Taklif va iltimosda doim some: Would you like some tea?
topics.mistake: "I don't have no" yoki "Do you have some" (oddiy savolda).

questions.q: There is ___ water in the bottle. It's empty.
She has ___ money. She is poor.
Are there ___ books on the shelf?
There are ___ students in the class. It's empty.
Is there ___ juice in the fridge?

questions.explain: Darak gapda "some" keladi: I have some questions.

questions.q: He has ___ friends. He is lonely.
questions.explain: "Lonely" — yolg'iz, demak do'sti yo'q. Shuning uchun "no friends".
Iltimos qilishda "some" ishlatiladi, savol shaklida bo'lsa ham.

topics.title: Future (will / going to)
topics.rule:
WILL + fe'l — o'sha zahoti qaror, va'da, taxmin (I think...): I'll open the window. I think it will rain.

am/is/are GOING TO + fe'l — oldindan rejalashtirilgan ish yoki ko'rinib turgan belgi: We are going to visit Paris. Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.

Inkor: won't (will not). Savol: Will + ega + fe'l? will dan keyin -s, to yo'q.

Signal so'zlar: tomorrownext weeknext yeartonightsoonin 2030I thinkprobably
topics.pattern: will - zahoti qaror/va'da/taxmin, going to - reja/belgi.
topics.tip: I think, probably, promise → WILL. Look!, tickets, plan → GOING TO.
topics.mistake: "will" dan keyin -s yoki to qo'yish; reja o'rniga will ishlatish.

questions.q: Look at the clouds! It ___ rain.
The phone is ringing. I ___ answer it.
We ___ visit Paris next year. We've bought tickets.
___ she go to the party next week?
She is pregnant. She ___ have a baby.
It's hot. I ___ open the window.
We ___ move house next month. It's decided.
questions.explain: Qaror qilingan reja → am/is/are going to.

questions.q: I'm sure you ___ pass the exam.
He ___ be a pilot. He has always wanted it.
questions.explain: Uzoq rejasi bor → is going to.

questions.q: I'm tired. I think I ___ go to bed.
questions.explain: "I think" va o'sha zahoti qaror, shuning uchun will.

questions.q: We ___ a party on Saturday. We've invited everyone.
questions.explain: Odamlarni taklif qilgan, demak oldindan reja: going to.

questions.q: ___ you going to buy a car?
questions.explain: Going to bilan savol: am/is/are + ega + going to.
"Tomorrow" — kelasi zamon. Ob-havo bashorati: will be.

questions.q: They ___ buy a house. They've saved money.
questions.explain: Pul yig'ib qo'yishgan, demak reja bor. "They" bilan "are going to".

topics.title: Signal so'zlar
topics.rule:
Present Simple: alwaysusuallyoftensometimesneverevery day

Present Continuous: nowat the momentright nowLook!Listen!

Past Simple: yesterdaylast weekagoin 2010last night

Future (kelasi zamon): tomorrownext week / next yeartonightsoonin 2030

WILL bilan keladigan signallar: I thinkprobablyI'm sureI promise — taxmin, va'da, o'sha zahoti qaror.

am/is/are GOING TO bilan keladigan signallar: Look!I've bought ticketsI've decidedplan — oldindan reja va ko'rinib turgan belgi.

Predloglar: at = soat, on = kun/sana, in = oy/yil/fasl.
topics.tip: always→Present Simple, now→Present Continuous, ago→Past Simple, tomorrow→Future.
topics.mistake: Signal so'zga qaramay gapni tarjima qilib taxmin qilish.

questions.explain: Every day = har kuni, takroriy ish.

questions.q: Soat bilan (7 o'clock) qaysi predlog kerak?
Kun nomi (Monday) bilan qaysi predlog kerak?
Oy va yil (May, 2020) bilan qaysi predlog kerak?
"I think" qaysi kelasi zamon shakli bilan keladi?
"Look at the clouds!" qaysi kelasi zamon shakli bilan keladi?
questions.explain: Ko'rinib turgan belgi → am/is/are going to.

questions.q: "I've bought tickets" (chipta olganman) qaysi shaklni talab qiladi?

questions.explain: won't = will not, kelasi zamonning inkor shakli.
Last night = kecha kechqurun, o'tgan zamon.
On Sundays = yakshanba kunlari, takroriy ish.
Right now = aynan hozir, davom etayotgan ish.
